_comment: ILLUSTRATIVE prices. These are NOT any vendor's real published rates and
are deliberately named by tier rather than by product, so that nothing
here goes stale into a wrong number that looks authoritative.
REPLACE these with your provider's current published prices before you
budget anything. Model pricing is the fastest-moving figure in this
course; see the Benchmark facts table in the curriculum for the same
single-source-of-truth discipline applied to benchmark numbers.
cache_read_multiplier: what a cached input token costs relative to a
fresh one. cache_write_multiplier: the premium to populate the cache.
